messages:
incident-bot: [SEV2] Multiple CUDA OOMs + container restarts observed in inference-prod-us-east-1. Affected hosts: gpu-73, gpu-91. Metric tie: paged-attention allocator resident growth >90% over 6h. Auto-retries and fallback triggered.

sophia (oncall): taking this. pinging runtime + infra: @liam @maria. any recent model or runtime deploys?

liam: no deploys from runtime in last 12h. I can see steady RSS creep on gpu-73 and intermittent paged alloc failures: `kvcache: slab_alloc failed: out_of_memory` in logs.

maria: seeing matching CUDA driver warnings on gpu-91: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` followed by container restart. Likely fragmentation + warmup pages accumulating.

sophia (oncall): plan (brief):
- isolate gpu-91 to stop new placements
- trigger kv-cache sweep + force compaction on affected nodes
- temporarily route heavy tails to fallback model (rwd-small) to reduce KV pressure
- watch customer impact and open support incident if timeouts increase

ops-runbook-bot: runbook snippet: 
```
# quick actions
kubectl cordon node/gpu-91
kubectl drain node/gpu-91 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
POST /ops/sweep_kvcache {"nodes":["gpu-73","gpu-91"],"mode":"aggressive"}
# toggle runtime config (can increase latency)
PATCH /config/runtime {"kv_cache.evict_fraction":0.35, "kv_cache.compact_immediately":true}
```

liam: starting KV sweep on gpu-73 now (curl to ops-api). logs: `sweep started, estimated 180s`

maria: cordoning gpu-91 and draining pods now. Some pods will reschedule to other nodes; sched pressure expected.

sophia (oncall): I'm shifting traffic for model: set routing rule to prefer rwd-small for low-latency endpoints. Doing gradual shift (10% -> 50%). Notifying growth to expect degraded tails.

support-lead: customer impact check: 7 customers reported elevated latency in last 90m, 2 request timeouts retried by clients. No billing-impacting errors reported yet. ETA for issue classification: potential partial degradation for high-concurrency tenants.

liam: sweep finished on gpu-73. Observed immediate free of 4.1GB reclaimed, resident dropped from 93%->62%. Watching for re-growth.

maria: drained gpu-91 completed, pod moved to gpu-84. On that node we see slightly higher peak latency but stable memory.

sophia (oncall): good progress. Next steps:
- keep aggressive compaction enabled for 20m
- monitor 95p latency and OOM events for 30m
- if memory re-growth resumes, we'll take a small restart window for the paged-alloc service across nodes (staggered)

liam: enabling compaction flag now. patch applied to runtime config (hash: `cfg-20260317-evict-1`).

maria: observed one more OOM on gpu-78 but container auto-recovered; no customer timeouts tied to that one.

support-lead: opening a customer notice draft: short ETA + mitigation steps + advice to retry on 503s. Will circulate for review.

sophia (oncall): handing off to maria for overnight watch at 03:00Z. If regressions appear (OOM spikes >3 in 15m or 95p > 500ms) escalate to oncall lead. :thumbsup:

maria: ack, taking watch. I'll leave aggressive compaction for now and set an alarm for memory growth >85% on any node.

incident-bot: Incident state changed -> mitigated (partial). Severity: SEV2 -> under watch. Next update scheduled in 30m.

sophia (oncall): thanks team. saving logs + traces to incident-6789012345 for postmortem.

maria: quick note for postmortem: include paged-attn allocator histogram, kv-slab-utilization over 12h, and any correlation with long-running prefix queries.

support-lead: I'll attach customer request IDs to the incident doc.

maria: handing back to oncall rotation at shift change if nothing spikes.

sophia (oncall): closing active action items; monitoring only. :white_check_mark:
